quality_highlights.aspect: Excellent structure: overview → prerequisites → build → API reference → architecture diagram → limitations table. ASCII package diagram is a standout pattern.
Messages follow a clean consistent pattern: emoji + workflow link + action verb. run-failure uses {status} for dynamic context. Footer includes {ai_credits_suffix} and {history_link}.

single_file_improvements.issue: Lines 84-87: Self-Hosted Runners section packs five distinct agent behaviors into one 80-word sentence. Should be converted to a bullet list for scannable enterprise documentation.

Lines 44-46: run-started is theatrical ('Specification Librarian online!'), run-success has redundant 'Report delivered!' and dual status indicators, run-failure reuses the content 📚 emoji on failure. Align with impeccable-skills-reviewer.md pattern.
